p: כָּל כְּלִי יוּצַר עָלַיִךְ לֹא יִצְלָח,
‘No weapon formed against you shall succeed,’
דְּהָא הוּא עַל כָּל דִּינֵי עָלְמָא אִתְפְּקַד.
for he was appointed over all the judgments of the world.”
That is, just before it, it is written,
“and I created the destroyer to ruin.”
This is in the manner of what they said
and I created the Torah as its antidote.”
And this is what it says, “the destroyer to ruin”:
for both of them are expounded
from “tohu va'vohu”: as the four kingdoms,
and also as the deeds of the wicked
which come through the evil inclination.
כָּל כְּלִי יוּצַר עָלַיִךְ לֹא יִצְלָח,
“No weapon formed against you shall succeed”:
one can overcome the evil inclination;
“and every tongue that rises against you
in the manner of what we say,
that in each of the seventy languages
there is one word from the Holy Tongue,
and Israel draws the holiness out of them
and out of the seventy nations.
And this is what it said,
דְּהָא הוּא עַל כָּל זִינֵי עָלְמָא אִתְפְּקַד,
“for he was appointed over all the weapons of the world”:
to conquer and overcome the evil inclination
and the nations of the world, which come from its power.
Earlier it is brought in the holy Zohar
that “all the weapons of the King and the battles
were entrusted into the hands of Dovid.”
זִינִין הוּא הַכֹּחַ לְנַצֵּחַ יֵצֶר הָרָע,
“Weapons” are the power to defeat the evil inclination,
שֶׁהוּא עַל יְדֵי תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה,
which comes through the Torah she'b'al peh,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א רב, א)
that breaks the evil inclination except the Torah.”
And this is what it says (Yeshayahu 54:17),
“This is the heritage of the servants of Hashem”:
for a servant is one who stands before the king,
and this is the attribute of malchus,
and the attribute of Dovid HaMelech, peace be upon him,
Likewise “zos” is the attribute of malchus
at the start of the amud, and in the Tikkunim
זֹהַר חָדָשׁ קי, סוֹף עַמּוּד ב
which is like an inheritance that has no interruption
meaning that they merit the entire Name Havayah,
the tav indicates the World to Come,
וְכֵן שַׁבָּת שֶׁהוּא מֵעֵין עוֹלָם הַבָּא
and so Shabbos, which is a semblance of the World to Come
was created with the letter tav,
וּמֵם סְתוּמָה מוֹרֶה עַל מֵ״ם מַלְכוּת
and the closed mem indicates the mem of malchus
so that they will never again go out
and it will never be severed.
which is the fallen sukkah of Dovid,
for Dovid supported them through ruach hakodesh
and the alef — the supernal Wonder
that shines upon the mem of malchus,
so that it becomes a closed mem
“Fortunate is the portion of the man
Dovid HaMelech, peace be upon him, who says this.
And this they will merit when Mashiach comes,
for then there will be victory
over the evil inclination and the nations of the world.
And it implies that every individual of Israel
It is like what we say
in the Yehi Ratzon for binding the lulav:
to bind them in Your Beis HaMikdash,” etc.
This is based on what they said
כְּאִילּוּ נִבְנָה בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בְּיָמָיו וְכוּלֵּי.
it is as though the Beis HaMikdash was built in his days,” etc.
when he rectifies his own individual soul,
so that it will be as though the Beis HaMikdash was built,
and the binding will be in the Beis HaMikdash;
and so the holiness of Dovid HaMelech,
peace be upon him, pertains to him:
